    import random
    rnd = random.Random(11)

    for _ in range(40):
        z2 = rnd.choice([-1, 0, 1, 2, -3]) + I*rnd.choice([-2, -1, 0, 1, 3])
        if z2 == 0:
            continue
        k = Rational(rnd.randint(1, 9), rnd.randint(1, 5))

    return (s1, s2)
